name: Location
description:
Geolocation information associated with the resolved location.

For coordinate-based or location-string lookups, only basic geographic
fields are returned (latitude, longitude, country, state, city, locality,
elevation).

For IP-based lookups, extended fields are also returned including
continent codes, country codes, district, zipcode, and other metadata.

location_string.description:
The location string provided in the request. Only present when the
`location` query parameter was used.

continent_code.description: Two-letter continent code. Returned for IP-based lookups only.

continent_name.description: Full name of the continent. Returned for IP-based lookups only.

country_code2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Returned for IP-based lookups only.

country_code3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Returned for IP-based lookups only.

country_name_official.description: Official name of the country. Returned for IP-based lookups only.

is_eu.description:
Indicates whether the country is a member of the European Union.
Returned for IP-based lookups only.

state_code.description: Standardized state or region code. Returned for IP-based lookups only.

district.description:
District or administrative subdivision. Returned for IP-based
lookups only.

locality.description: Smaller locality or neighborhood within the city.

zipcode.description:
ZIP or postal code of the location. Returned for IP-based
lookups only.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the resolved location.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the resolved location.

elevation.description: Elevation above sea level at the location, in meters.
